summary.text: Rebekah Skaggs is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 97 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Republican Bobby McCool.
According to her campaign website, Skaggs spent 32 years as a classroom teacher in Johnson County Schools and is running on education, economic opportunity, health care and community safety.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, Rebekah Skaggs, who goes by Becky, earned a bachelor's and master's degree from Morehead State University in elementary education and as a reading specialist.
The site lists 32 years as a Johnson County Schools teacher, a Wal-Mart Teacher of the Year award in 2008, and service as a Kentucky Education Association Uniserv director from 2011 to 2020.
It also lists her as president of the Johnson County Democratic Women's Club and a member of Paintsville First Christian Church.
Skaggs advanced from the Democratic primary after the May 19, 2026, primary was canceled.
Her campaign site describes a platform of fully funding public education, supporting a living wage, affordable health care and safe communities in Johnson, Martin and part of Pike Counties.
